title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 17:12 UTC on 18 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 18 日 17:12 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest complete-minute estimated Kp = 0.33 (label 0P). Last-180-sample maximum is 1.00; published-window maximum is 1.67 (at 11:34 UTC). Hours through 10:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window. Residual 11:00 UTC slice: peak 1.67 / 2M (45 samples). Completed bins 12:00–16:00 UTC closed at 0.67 / 1.00 / 0.67 / 0.67 / 0.67 respectively. In-progress 17:00 UTC bin: 0.33 / 0P after 13 samples. estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新完整分鐘估計 Kp = 0.33（標籤 0P）。近 180 筆最大 1.00；公開窗最大 1.67（11:34 UTC）。至 10:00 UTC 已滾出公開窗。殘留 11:00 UTC 切片峰值 1.67／2M（45 筆）。已結束 12:00–16:00 區間分別收在 0.67／1.00／0.67／0.67／0.67。進行中 17:00 UTC：0.33／0P（13 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a lone new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~358 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file.
